infobox.usage: This key has no usage. Pinewood hotel room 206 on Streets of Tarkov is always unlocked.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Pinewood hotel room 206 key (Pnwd 206) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the rooms inside the Pinewood hotel.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Room 206 on the second floor of the northern Pinewood hotel building at Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Dead Scav
- 1x Safe (Erroneously locked and containing no loot, can be unlocked with USEC cottage second safe key)
- Loose loot (Provisions, Energy elements, Flammable materials)
